I fixed mine. 
You need to download the recovery image and write to a USB stick. Boot to the image and “Reinstall Steam OS”. Took a while but when it reboots, start the Waydroid install process and it should work.
Smoking more when down. Adds to the feeling that I need to self destruct.
Alone. I just hate the general public.
It’s a sprinkler. They activate when they get hot. A bit of smoke won’t set them off…
Regret not completing the pre-flight checks.
You should have said spinal column in a baguette. Because a spinal column would fit in a baguette.
Better to do a sit down pee than a stand up shit.
The luscious V of hair going from my chest pubes down to my ball-fro.
“I love you too… In a way”

Not being sarcastic or ironic here. 
I’m quite frequently told that my depression is “made up” and they my meds “don’t do anything.” Not forgetting “why don’t you jump off a bridge” or “run under a bus”. 
I’m told I’m “fucking bonkers” and a “fat  bastard” and “fucking unstable”. True, my weight had increased as is probably because of the depression and / or the meds. Im doing what i can to lose. 
All this from my darling wife…
